platform: CFRC 101.9 FM Kingston Digital MP3 Email and Physical Music Submission Route
manual_review_reason: CFRC accepts digital files only through its published music mailbox and requires 320-kbps MP3s collected in one ZIP or archive, with explicit tracks identified and metadata, artist information and optional artwork checked before delivery. Physical media is also accepted. A human must prepare and approve the package, choose one route, and keep the optional account-based paid !earshot Distro workflow separate.

platform: JOY 94.9 Melbourne Stream-Link Email and Physical Music Submission Route
manual_review_reason: JOY asks artists who are Australian, independent or part of LGBTIQA+ communities and whose music fits its daytime or specialist sound to send a stream link through the official music contact, with a physical CD and bio as an alternative. A human must confirm eligibility and programme fit, select the route and approve the pitch. The official music email is protected in the fetched page and was not decoded.

platform: 2XXfm 98.3 Canberra Global Download-Link Music Submission Form
manual_review_reason: The official form accepts artists worldwide and requests identity and contact data, a brief biography, social links and a high-quality downloadable WAV, FLAC or 320-kbps-equivalent audio link. It includes a hidden validation field and CAPTCHA. A human must verify the asset link and rights, complete the fields normally and solve the CAPTCHA without automation.

platform: Cam FM 97.2 Cambridge Direct Head of Music Email Submission Route
manual_review_reason: Cam FM explicitly directs music submissions to its dedicated Head of Music mailbox but does not publish complete file-format, attachment, download-link, release-window or metadata rules on the contact page. A human must prepare a concise inquiry or submission, confirm the preferred asset format and approve all links and copy before sending.

platform: University Radio Nottingham Artist Collaboration Pre-Submission Inquiry Route
manual_review_reason: URN publishes a dedicated contact for artists who would like to work with the station, but it does not state that unsolicited audio may be sent or provide file, link, metadata or eligibility requirements. The safe authorized action is an asset-free human inquiry asking for the current music-consideration process; no music, attachments or private links should be delivered until URN replies.
